name: PDL break

story.template: {symbol} below PDL {line:,.2f} at {at} · watching for the fade

note: Stage 1 of the PD fade (design 1 Nov 2026): a silent heads-up when a 5m bar first closes below yesterday's low (continuous, so a gap open counts on the 09:15 bar's close), 09:20-11:00 like the PDL fade so no heads-up goes out once the fade can no longer fire. No trade block: never graded, never queued, no desk verdict; side long is for the chip colour only. One per stock per day (cooldown 400 min). Observed over 20 sessions (1-30 Oct 2026, 213 stocks): a close below PDL fell at least 0.5 % further 76 % of the time and came back to touch PDL 86 %. The trade is PDL fade: before 11:00 with a 1 % run, 4 fires/day, 83 % target first, median R:R 1:0.3, +0.17 R per trade.
